violations.text: Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Dishes and utensils were removed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Sausage patties were observed held at 47 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Sausage patties were out of temperature for an unknown amount of time. Sausage patties were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Prep unit ambient was observed at 41 DF, and all other food in unit was observed in temperature. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Various food was observed held between 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit in the 2 door reach-in. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ambient of 2 door reach-in was observed at 42 DF. Temperature dial was turned colder and ambient was observed at 34 DF. Establishment is to monitor the internal food temperatures in the 2 door reach-in to ensure all food is staying at 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the storage area. All single service items must be stored off of the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Ice machine -Storage racks -Walk-in cooler fans -Prep unit/prep station -2 door reach-in fans Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

-The floor in the walk-in freezer, and service area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. -The floor in the dry storage area has an accumulation of soil residue, old droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

The ceiling lights in the kitchen area were observed stained from a previous leak and in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Service order has been placed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of pink residue. Surfaces cleaned at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/16/2026
The wall behind the syrup containers and area under front prep line were observed with an accumulation of food debris/residue. New Violation. Correct By: 10/03/2024
